offering_description.value: Management company that oversees operations and capital allocation for CompoSecure and runs a permanent capital platform (GPGI) to acquire high-quality businesses. CompoSecure makes metal payment cards sold to card issuers such as banks.

quotes.quote: Resolute Holdings is a management company responsible for overseeing the operations and capital allocation strategies of CompoSecure.

Resolute Holdings is a management company responsible for overseeing the operations and capital allocation strategies of GPGI, Inc.. Through this structure, Resolute is the manager of a permanent capital platform and is focused on acquiring high-quality businesses that can achieve their full potential through the implementation and deployment of the Resolute Operating System.
